newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-SWEDES ANNOUNCE SQUAD TO FACE SCOTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDES ANNOUNCE SQUAD TO FACE SCOTS.

text.p: Sweden have anounced a 20-man squad for their World Cup qualifier against Scotland in Gothenburg next week.
The Swedes, who lost 1-0 in Scotland last November, need a victory to cut their opponents' current healthy lead in qualifying group four.
Goalkeepers: Magnus Hedman (AIK), Thomas Ravelli (IFK Gothenburg)
Defenders: Patrik Andersson (Borussia Monchengladbach), Joachim Bjorklund (Glasgow Rangers), Christian Karlsson (Malmo FF), Pontus Kamark (Leicester), Jozo Matovac (Orgryte), Gary Sundgren (AIK).

Midfielders: Niclas Alexandersson (Gothenburg), Jesper Blomqvist (Milan), Hakan Mild (Real Sociedad), Stefan Schwarz (Fiorentina), Jonas Thern (Rome), Peter Wibran (Helsingborg), Par Zetterberg (Anderlecht).
Forwards: Andreas Andersson (IFK Gothenburg), Kennet Andersson (Bologna), Martin Dahlin (Borussia Monchengladbach), Jorgen Pettersson (Borussia Mochengladbach), Pascal Simpson (AIK).
